_doc: Per-storefront SIGNATURE layer (R2 — recognizable storefronts). Keyed by the storefront's curation key (building-tiers.*.json), with a matchName fallback. A thin, evidence-bound override that makes a specific shop read as itself by FORM (awning profile/color, frame, transom text, glazing, blade shape, sidewalk seating) — never by real name (claim model: text stays category-true, not branded). Colors are token NAMES resolved against SIGNATURE_PALETTE in palette.js at apply time (no raw hex here, so the no-miss conformance gate holds). Application rule: a present key wins over the kit default; absent keys fall through. Building-level signals (parapet, AC) use the BIN-keyed signatureContract.js surface, not this file.
